posts.title: Developers, Factory Workers, and the AI Replacement Myth
posts.description: Cover image credits: Dan Sandoval / Great Wall Motor Co. Ltd. The Clock-In Factory workers clock in when they arrive at work. They punch their badge, scan in, or log their presence in some system. The system knows they're there. They get paid for their time on the assembly line. They get paid to assemble, not to think.
